item.title: Lin Qiong-xian (林瓊仙)
item.description: Lin Qiong-xian (林瓊仙) Lin Qiong-xian (林瓊仙) was a prominent member of the Fengyuan family and the mother of biochemist |廖述宗 (Liao Shu-zong).

item.title: Lin Yuan-qing (林元清)
item.description: Lin Yuan-qing (林元清) Lin Yuan-qing (林元清) is a Taiwanese American orthopedic surgeon who built a long practice in Alhambra, California, after immigrating from Taiwan.

item.description: Pastor Pingtung Lai (賴炳烔) Pastor Pingtung Lai (賴炳烔, Lai Ping-tung) was a Taiwanese Presbyterian pastor, Bible Society pioneer, and evangelist.

item.title: Sam Chang (張善良)
item.description: Sam Chang (張善良) Sam Chang (張善良, born 1960) is a Taiwanese American real estate developer known as the “旅館開發大王” (Hotel Development King) in New York’s Taiwanese American community.
